# T402 Protocol

> Open-source HTTP-native payment protocol for USDT/USDT0 and other stablecoins. Compatible with Tether WDK.

## Overview

T402 is a payment protocol that uses HTTP 402 status codes. Flow: client requests resource -> server responds 402 + PaymentRequirements -> client signs off-chain -> resubmits with signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header -> server verifies via facilitator and serves resource.

Architecture: Transport (HTTP, MCP, A2A) x Scheme (exact, upto, exact-direct) x Network (13 chain families: EVM, Solana, TON, TRON, NEAR, Aptos, Tezos, Polkadot, Stacks, Cosmos, BTC, Stellar, Spark)

**Compatible with [Tether WDK](https://wdk.tether.io)** — bring your own wallet, or use Tether WDK as the underlying wallet layer. t402 provides the payment protocol; WDK provides the wallet.

Protocol version: 2 (current). Version 1 is legacy.

## Scheme Types

- exact: Fixed-amount transfers (EIP-3009 on EVM, SPL on Solana, TRC20 on TRON, Jettons on TON, FA2 on Tezos, SIP-010 on Stacks)
- upto: Up-to-amount authorization (EIP-2612 on EVM) [draft]
- exact-direct: On-chain transfer proof (NEAR, Aptos, Polkadot, Cosmos, BTC, Stellar, Spark)

## SDKs

- **TypeScript** (v2.9.0): 47 packages total.
  - Core: `@t402/core`, `@t402/extensions`, `@t402/policy`, `@t402/observability`
  - Mechanisms (13): `@t402/evm`, `@t402/evm-core`, `@t402/svm`, `@t402/ton`, `@t402/tron`, `@t402/near`, `@t402/aptos`, `@t402/tezos`, `@t402/polkadot`, `@t402/stacks`, `@t402/cosmos`, `@t402/btc`, `@t402/stellar`, `@t402/spark`
  - HTTP middleware: `@t402/express`, `@t402/hono`, `@t402/fastify`, `@t402/next`, `@t402/axios`, `@t402/fetch`, `@t402/quick`, `@t402/facilitator-embedded`
  - UI: `@t402/paywall`, `@t402/react`, `@t402/vue`, `@t402/react-native`
  - WDK compatibility: `@t402/wdk`, `@t402/wdk-bridge`, `@t402/wdk-gasless`, `@t402/wdk-multisig`, `@t402/wdk-defi`, `@t402/wdk-protocol`, `@t402/wdk-ton`, `@t402/wdk-ton-gasless`, `@t402/wdk-tron-gasfree`, `@t402/wdk-lending`, `@t402/wdk-fiat`, `@t402/wdk-swap-jupiter`, `@t402/wdk-facilitator`
  - AI agent: `@t402/mcp` (34 tools), `@t402/a2a`, `@t402/erc8004`
  - Tools: `@t402/cli`
- **Go** (v1.13.1): `github.com/t402-io/t402/sdks/go` — all 13 mechanisms, MCP (6 tools)
- **Python** (v1.13.1): `t402` on PyPI — all 13 mechanisms, MCP (6 tools)
- **Java** (v1.13.1): `io.t402:t402-sdk` on Maven Central — all 13 mechanisms, MCP (22 tools), Spring Boot 4 compatible

## Transport Types

- HTTP: 402 status code with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / PAYMENT-REQUIRED / PAYMENT-RESPONSE headers
- MCP: Model Context Protocol for AI agents (TS 34 tools, Java 22, Go 6, Py 6). Compatible with Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini.
- A2A: Agent-to-Agent protocol via `@t402/a2a`

## Agent Economy Features

- **ERC-8004 Trustless Agents**: identity + reputation via `@t402/erc8004`
- **MCP server**: 34 tools in TS including autoPay, wdkTransfer, verifySignature, bazaar lookup
- **`@t402/payments-mcp`**: one-command install for Claude Code / Codex / Gemini
- **A2A transport**: agent-to-agent payment flows

## PaymentRequired (402 Response)

When a server requires payment, it responds with HTTP 402 and a JSON body:

```json
{
  "t402Version": 2,
  "error": "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header is required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://api.example.com/premium-data",
    "description": "Access to premium market data",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "10000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x209693Bc6afc0C5328bA36FaF03C514EF312287C",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 60,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USDC",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ],
  "extensions": {}
}
```

### PaymentRequired Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| t402Version | number | Yes | Protocol version (must be 2) |
| error | string | No | Human-readable error message |
| resource | object | Yes | ResourceInfo describing the protected resource |
| accepts | array | Yes | Array of PaymentRequirements defining acceptable payment methods |
| extensions | object | No | Protocol extensions data |

### PaymentRequirements Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| scheme | string | Yes | Payment scheme identifier (e.g., "exact") |
| network | string | Yes | Blockchain network in CAIP-2 format (e.g., "eip155:8453") |
| amount | string | Yes | Required payment amount in atomic token units |
| asset | string | Yes | Token contract address |
| payTo | string | Yes | Recipient wallet address |
| maxTimeoutSeconds | number | Yes | Maximum time allowed for payment completion |
| extra | object | No | Scheme-specific additional information |

### ResourceInfo Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| url | string | Yes | URL of the protected resource |
| description | string | No | Human-readable description |
| mimeType | string | No | MIME type of the expected response |

## PaymentPayload (Client Submission)

The client sends a signed payment authorization:

```json
{
  "t402Version": 2,
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://api.example.com/premium-data",
    "description": "Access to premium market data",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepted": {
    "scheme": "exact",
    "network": "eip155:8453",
    "amount": "10000",
    "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
    "payTo": "0x209693Bc6afc0C5328bA36FaF03C514EF312287C",
    "maxTimeoutSeconds": 60,
    "extra": { "name": "USDC", "version": "2" }
  },
  "payload": {
    "signature": "0x2d6a...",
    "authorization": {
      "from": "0x857b06519E91e3A54538791bDbb0E22373e36b66",
      "to": "0x209693Bc6afc0C5328bA36FaF03C514EF312287C",
      "value": "10000",
      "validAfter": "1740672089",
      "validBefore": "1740672154",
      "nonce": "0xf374..."
    }
  },
  "extensions": {}
}
```

### PaymentPayload Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| t402Version | number | Yes | Protocol version identifier |
| resource | object | No | ResourceInfo for the resource being accessed |
| accepted | object | Yes | PaymentRequirements chosen by the client |
| payload | object | Yes | Scheme-specific payment data (e.g., EIP-3009 signature + authorization) |
| extensions | object | No | Protocol extensions data |

## Facilitator API

The facilitator handles payment verification and blockchain settlement.

### POST /verify

Verifies a payment authorization without executing the transaction.

**Request:**
```json
{
  "paymentPayload": { /* PaymentPayload */ },
  "paymentRequirements": { /* PaymentRequirements */ }
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "isValid": true,
  "payer": "0x857b06519E91e3A54538791bDbb0E22373e36b66"
}
```

### POST /settle

Executes a verified payment on the blockchain.

**Request:** Same as /verify

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "payer": "0x857b06519E91e3A54538791bDbb0E22373e36b66",
  "transaction": "0x1234...",
  "network": "eip155:8453"
}
```

### GET /supported

Returns supported payment schemes, networks, and signer addresses.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "kinds": [
    { "t402Version": 2, "scheme": "exact", "network": "eip155:8453" },
    { "t402Version": 2, "scheme": "exact", "network": "eip155:42161" }
  ],
  "extensions": [],
  "signers": {
    "eip155:*": ["0x1234..."],
    "solana:*": ["CKPKJWNdJEqa81x7CkZ14BVPiY6y16Sxs7owznqtWYp5"]
  }
}
```

## SDK Code Examples

### TypeScript - Client

```typescript
import { ExactEVMClient } from '@t402/evm/exact/client';
import { createT402HTTPClient } from '@t402/fetch';

const client = createT402HTTPClient({
  signers: [{
    scheme: 'exact',
    network: 'eip155:8453',
    signer: new ExactEVMClient({ privateKey: '0x...' })
  }],
  facilitatorUrl: 'https://facilitator.t402.io'
});

const response = await client.fetch('https://api.example.com/premium');
```

### TypeScript - Server (Express)

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { createT402Middleware } from '@t402/express';
import { ExactEVMServer } from '@t402/evm/exact/server';

const app = express();

const t402 = createT402Middleware({
  mechanisms: [new ExactEVMServer()],
  facilitatorUrl: 'https://facilitator.t402.io',
  price: { amount: '10000', currency: 'USDC' },
  payTo: '0xYourAddress',
  networks: ['eip155:8453'],
});

app.get('/premium', t402, (req, res) => {
  res.json({ data: 'premium content' });
});
```

### Go - Client

```go
package main

import (
    "github.com/t402-io/t402/sdks/go/client"
    "github.com/t402-io/t402/sdks/go/mechanisms/evm"
)

func main() {
    signer, _ := evm.NewExactEVMClient("0xPrivateKey")
    c := client.New(
        client.WithSigner("exact", "eip155:8453", signer),
        client.WithFacilitator("https://facilitator.t402.io"),
    )
    resp, _ := c.Get("https://api.example.com/premium")
}
```

### Go - Server

```go
package main

import (
    "github.com/t402-io/t402/sdks/go/server"
    "github.com/t402-io/t402/sdks/go/mechanisms/evm"
)

func main() {
    srv := server.New(
        server.WithMechanism(evm.NewExactEVMServer()),
        server.WithFacilitator("https://facilitator.t402.io"),
        server.WithPrice("10000", "USDC"),
        server.WithPayTo("0xYourAddress"),
        server.WithNetworks("eip155:8453"),
    )
    http.Handle("/premium", srv.Protect(handler))
}
```

### Python - Client

```python
from t402 import T402Client

client = T402Client(
    private_key="0x...",
    facilitator_url="https://facilitator.t402.io",
    network="eip155:8453"
)
response = client.get("https://api.example.com/premium")
```

### Python - Server (FastAPI)

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from t402.fastapi import require_payment

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/premium")
@require_payment(
    amount="10000",
    currency="USDC",
    pay_to="0xYourAddress",
    network="eip155:8453",
    facilitator_url="https://facilitator.t402.io"
)
async def premium():
    return {"data": "premium content"}
```

### Java - Client

```java
import io.t402.sdk.client.T402Client;

T402Client client = T402Client.builder()
    .privateKey("0x...")
    .facilitatorUrl("https://facilitator.t402.io")
    .network("eip155:8453")
    .build();

HttpResponse response = client.get("https://api.example.com/premium");
```

### Java - Server (Spring)

```java
import io.t402.sdk.spring.T402Filter;

@Configuration
public class T402Config {
    @Bean
    public T402Filter t402Filter() {
        return T402Filter.builder()
            .facilitatorUrl("https://facilitator.t402.io")
            .amount("10000")
            .currency("USDC")
            .payTo("0xYourAddress")
            .network("eip155:8453")
            .build();
    }
}
```

## Extensions

Extensions enable modular optional functionality beyond core payment mechanics. Servers advertise extensions in the `extensions` field of PaymentRequired, and clients echo them back in PaymentPayload.

### Bazaar (Resource Discovery)

Extension key: `bazaar`

Enables facilitators to catalog and index t402-enabled resources. Servers declare input/output schemas for their endpoints, allowing automatic API discovery.

Two variants:
- QueryDiscoveryExtension: For GET/HEAD/DELETE requests (query parameters)
- BodyDiscoveryExtension: For POST/PUT/PATCH requests (request body)

### Sign-In-With-X (SIWx)

Extension key: `siwx`

CAIP-122 compliant wallet-based identity assertions. Allows clients to prove wallet ownership for authenticated pricing.

Supported signature schemes: eip191, eip712, eip1271, eip6492, siws (Solana), sep10 (Stellar).

### Payment Identifier

Extension key: `paymentId`

Attach unique identifiers for correlation, idempotency, and audit trails. Servers declare an ID in requirements, clients can append a client-side ID.

## WDK (Wallet Development Kit)

@t402/wdk integrates with the Tether WDK for multi-chain wallet management:
- Multi-chain support: EVM, TON, Solana, TRON
- Cross-chain bridging via LayerZero OFT (USDT0)
- Token swaps via Velora protocol
- Balance aggregation across chains
- T402-compatible signer generation

```typescript
import { T402WDK } from '@t402/wdk';

const wdk = new T402WDK(seedPhrase, {
  arbitrum: 'https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc',
  base: 'https://mainnet.base.org',
});

const signer = await wdk.getSigner('arbitrum');
const signers = await wdk.getAllSigners();
```

## MCP Tools

The @t402/mcp package provides 11 tools for AI agents:

### Base Tools (6)
| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| t402/getBalance | Get token balances for a wallet on a specific network |
| t402/getAllBalances | Get balances across all supported networks |
| t402/pay | Execute a stablecoin payment (USDC, USDT, USDT0) |
| t402/payGasless | Execute a gasless payment using ERC-4337 |
| t402/getBridgeFee | Get fee quote for bridging USDT0 via LayerZero |
| t402/bridge | Bridge USDT0 between chains |

### WDK Tools (5, requires seed phrase)
| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| wdk/getWallet | Get WDK wallet info and supported chains |
| wdk/getBalances | Get multi-chain token balances from WDK wallet |
| wdk/transfer | Send stablecoins from WDK wallet |
| wdk/swap | Swap tokens using Velora protocol |
| t402/autoPay | Smart payment orchestrator - fetch URL, handle 402, pay, return content |

## Security Considerations

- Private keys never leave the client. The protocol uses off-chain signatures (EIP-3009, EIP-2612) that authorize specific transfers without exposing keys.
- Always verify payment before serving resources. Validate amount, payTo, and deadline fields.
- EIP-3009 nonces prevent replay attacks at the smart contract level.
- Time constraints (validAfter/validBefore) limit authorization lifetime.
- Use facilitator verification (POST /verify) before settlement for defense-in-depth.
- Report vulnerabilities via GitHub Security Advisories or security@t402.io.

## Error Codes

Error codes follow the format T402-CXXX:
- T402-1xxx: Client errors (invalid input, malformed requests)
- T402-2xxx: Server errors (internal failures)
- T402-3xxx: Facilitator errors (verification/settlement failures)
- T402-4xxx: Chain errors (blockchain-specific)
- T402-5xxx: Bridge errors (cross-chain operations)
